results.name: Great Wall survey
results.description:
The Ming Great Wall (明長城; Ming changcheng), built by the Ming dynasty (1368–1644), forms the most visible parts of the Great Wall of China today. A comprehensive archaeological survey, using advanced technologies, has concluded that the Ming walls measure 8,850 km (5,500 mi) from Jiayu Pass in the west to the sea in Shanhai Pass, then looping over to terminate in Manchuria at the Hushan Great Wall.

See https://skfb.ly/RBvT for tower detail.

results.name: TERMINATOR: T-800 Endo-Skeleton (Damaged)
results.description:
**Terminator 800 Series Endo-Skeleton from the T1 movie (at the end)**

This is just my re-designed T-800, with alot of wear and metalic degradation on the edges.

I tried to keep it as low-poly/game-ready as possible, but its harder than I thought; given all the parts and hydraulics.

I chose this animation scene to portray the T-800 not stopping until its target is terminated. Also, its pretty damn terrifying just imagining being chased by it.

If you want to use this model let me know what for in the comments, I'll take a peek at ur work ;)

results.name: Terminator T-800 [SFM]
results.description:
Terminator is an American media franchise created by James Cameron and Gale Anne Hurd. It is considered to be of the cyberpunk subgenre of science fiction.[4][5] The franchise primarily focuses on a post-apocalyptic war between a synthetic intelligence known as Skynet, and a surviving resistance of humans led by John Connor. Skynet uses an arsenal of cyborgs known as Terminators, designed to mimic humans and infiltrate the resistance. A prominent model throughout the films is the T-800, commonly known as the Terminator and portrayed by Arnold Schwarzenegger. Time travel is a common aspect of the franchise, with humans and Terminators often sent back to alter the past and change the outcome of the future.
Ported from: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1932935409

results.name: Biserica „Sfântul Mucenic Dumitru”
results.description: Monumentul de cult se află în partea de nord a localității Valea Nucetului, parte componentă a orașului Urlați, Construcția bisericii de la Valea Nucetului a început în anul 1911 și a fost terminată în anul 1926. Pictura a fost realizată de pictorul Gheorghe Baba din Caransebeș. În prezent, biserica este abandonată și se află în ruină.

results.name: Roman Fort with Gatehouse
results.description: A Roman fort with square floor plan, consisting of a U-shaped, tile-covered three-story stone building and a crenellated gatehouse terminating the building. The resulting inner courtyard is surrounded by an arcade with multi-layered columns, a barrel vault and stone arches. All stones and bricks in the 3d model are individually shaped and textured bodies.
